summary.en: This edition focuses on continuous QC for large proteomics cohorts, quantitative benchmarks with defined microbial communities, and interactive downstream analysis.
summary.zh: 本期关注大规模蛋白组的持续质控、已知微生物群落的定量基准，以及交互式下游分析。

en: This edition focuses on continuous QC for large proteomics cohorts, quantitative benchmarks with defined microbial communities, and interactive downstream analysis.
The priority is to connect continuous QC with benchmarks that measure quantitative accuracy as well as identification depth. Several journal sources were inaccessible, so coverage is incomplete.
zh: 本期关注大规模蛋白组的持续质控、已知微生物群落的定量基准，以及交互式下游分析。
值得深入的是将持续质控与同时考察定量准确度、鉴定深度的基准结合。部分期刊来源不可访问，本次覆盖不完整。

papers.title: LAMPrEY: a Python-Based Automated Quality Control Tool for Large-Scale Proteomics Datasets

commentary.en: LAMPrEY integrates MaxQuant, RawTools, interactive QC dashboards and an API into a traceable processing workflow for large TMT cohorts. The authors demonstrate longitudinal monitoring with TMT11 data from 910 Enterococcus faecium isolates, offering a practical design for embedding QC in continuously operating analysis pipelines. The abstract and software documentation do not establish anomaly-detection error rates, cross-instrument performance or gains over other QC tools.
commentary.zh: LAMPrEY 将 MaxQuant、RawTools、交互式质控面板和程序接口整合为 TMT 大队列的自动处理流程，并记录处理参数以支持可追溯分析。作者以 910 株屎肠球菌的 TMT11 数据展示纵向监测，值得借鉴的是把批次质控接入持续运行的数据处理系统。当前仅核查摘要及官方软件说明，尚不能判断异常检测误差、跨仪器适用性或相对其他质控工具的增益。

publication_status.en: Version of record; earlier May 2026 preprint
publication_status.zh: 正式版；此前已有 2026 年 5 月预印本

read_scope.en: Reviewed the publisher-deposited Crossref abstract, full authorship and online-date metadata, plus the official software homepage; publisher full text was inaccessible, and supplements and code were not audited or reproduced.
read_scope.zh: 已读出版社提交至 Crossref 的摘要、完整作者和首发元数据及官方软件首页；出版社正文入口不可读，未核查全文、补充材料或复现。

papers.title: Asymmetric Track Lossless Analyzer Mass Spectrometry Improves Metaproteomic Analysis of a Complex Taxonomic Ground-Truth Microbial Community
papers.journal: Journal of the American Society for Mass Spectrometry

commentary.en: A defined community of 30 organisms spanning a wide abundance range benchmarks Astral against Orbitrap Fusion metaproteomics, including FAIMS trade-offs. The authors report that FAIMS increases peptide identifications while reducing precision and throughput, underscoring why known-composition benchmarks should evaluate quantification and taxonomic assignment rather than identification counts alone. Only the abstract was reviewed: numerical gains, search settings and error control remain unchecked, and instrument-vendor coauthors mean this is not a fully independent evaluation.
commentary.zh: 研究用 30 种生物组成、丰度跨度较大的已知混合群落，比较 Astral 与 Orbitrap Fusion 的宏蛋白组测量深度、准确度和精密度，并评估 FAIMS。作者报告 FAIMS 增加肽段鉴定，却降低精密度与通量，提示软件基准不能只比较鉴定数量；这一已知组成设计也适合检验低丰度物种的定量与分类归属。当前仅读摘要，未核验具体增益、搜索与错误率设置，且研究包含仪器厂商作者，不能视为完全独立的算法评测。

read_scope.en: Reviewed the publisher abstract, byline, online date and supplement description; main text and supplementary benchmarks were not reviewed or reproduced.
read_scope.zh: 已核查出版社摘要、作者、首发日期及补充材料目录；未读正文或补充评测，未复现。

papers.title: Manchester Proteome Profiler: A User-Friendly Platform for Quantitative Proteomic Analysis

commentary.en: Manchester Proteome Profiler combines protein-intensity filtering, normalization, imputation, differential analysis and clustering in an R Shiny interface, with SAINTexpress support for affinity-purification and proximity-labeling experiments. A KRAS proximity-biotinylation example illustrates reproducible protein clusters and a useful multi-input interactive workflow. The abstract does not provide systematic tests of missingness assumptions, statistical error control or competing pipelines, so it does not establish more accurate imputation or differential analysis.
commentary.zh: Manchester Proteome Profiler 用 R Shiny 整合蛋白强度表的过滤、归一化、缺失值填补、差异分析与聚类，并接入 SAINTexpress 处理亲和纯化和邻近标记数据。作者以 KRAS 邻近生物素化数据展示可重复的蛋白聚类，适合借鉴其多软件输入和交互式分析设计。摘要尚未提供缺失机制、统计错误率或替代流程的系统比较，不能据此认为其填补与差异分析更准确。
